poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: Takes damage each turn, ignoring Defense.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Takes damage each turn. Stacks up to 3 times.

burn.name: Burn
burn.desc: Takes damage each turn. Spreads fire to flammable ground.

stun.name: Stun
stun.desc: Loses the Action next turn but can still move.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: Cannot attack; flees from the source.

marked.name: Marked
marked.desc: Attacks against this unit gain hit chance.

taunted.name: Taunted
taunted.desc: Must attack the one who taunted it.

silenced.name: Hushed
silenced.desc: A skill was erased by the Hush.

shielded.name: Shield Wall
shielded.desc: Counts as being in half cover.

defending.name: Defending
defending.desc: +20 Dodge and +25% critical defense until next turn.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.desc: Attacks the first enemy that moves in range.
